name: Ukihashi Tsubame
source:
She is a first-year student who was recruited as a member of the service committee after she was seen masturbating alone in the classroom. 

She is easily swayed, but has a surprisingly sharp temperament.

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk004/]official site[/url]]
